text:
Camila López: OrbitLabs flagged April invoice — our exported tokens show 2,004,982 but their SDK metrics show 2,119,271. they see a gap after we rolled the regional egress change to eu-west-2.
Ethan Brooks: Do we have an export query and any server ingestion logs for that region/time window?
Camila López: export used: SELECT count(*) FROM tokens_export WHERE customer='orbitlabs' AND month='2026-04' AND region='eu-west-2'; result=2004982. customer provided SDK count=2119271.
Priya Singh: Two big possibilities: (1) client double-sent during their retry surge and we deduped correctly, or (2) some egress failures caused successful client calls that never reached ingestion. need logs.
Ethan Brooks: I checked proxy logs — noticed repeated 502s to our regional ingress on 2026-04-12 02:14-02:21Z, with client retries that included header X-Cli-Req. sample: 2026-04-12T02:15:03Z WARN proxy_forward failed status=502 req_id=ol-987
Camila López: Client claims they got 200s on their side for many of those retries. could be a split-brain where client saw success from local cache.
Priya Singh: What's retention on regional ingress raw payloads?
Ethan Brooks: We keep raw payloads 14 days for eu clusters. we're at day 6 so we can reconstruct. plan: (A) join proxy logs with ingress raw payloads by req_id and timestamp, (B) compute unique client_req signatures (X-Cli-Req or client_ts+payload_hash) to reconcile.
Alejandra (Revenue Ops): Risk tolerance? OrbitLabs is on a committed plan; they may request a credit for any undercount. I can approve provisional credit up to $200 while we investigate.
Camila López: ballpark impact if undercount is ~114k tokens at $0.0001/token ~ $11.4 so within provisional limit. but if it's higher because of models/embeds mix might change.
Ethan Brooks: I'll start reconstruction job for window 2026-04-12T00:00:00Z to 2026-04-13T00:00:00Z. ETA 10 hours. will post delta and checksum.
Priya Singh: Finance: mark invoice 2026-04 OrbitLabs as under review, create ticket FIN-4932 and attach this thread.
Billing Bot: Ticket FIN-4932 created: OrbitLabs regional egress token discrepancy.
Alejandra (Revenue Ops): label FIN-4932 "provisional-credit-applied" and note escalation threshold $500. Camila, send OrbitLabs: "We've applied a provisional credit up to $200 while we reconcile logs; ETA 2 business days."
Camila López: sent. I'll update FIN-4932 with customer reply. thanks — will follow up when reconstruction completes.
Ethan Brooks: reconstruction started. I'll include the SQL used: SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(x_cli_req, concat(client_ts,'|',payload_hash))) FROM ingress_raw WHERE customer='orbitlabs' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-12T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-13T00:00:00Z';
Priya Singh: sounds good. once recon results in FIN-4932 we'll issue final credit or reversal.
Camila López: closing loop: FIN-4932 assigned to FinanceOps.
